visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Loops Instead of Four Hand-Written Sums
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every element of the result is written out by hand. Use nested loops over a named size. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Two nested loops scale to any size by changing N. The unrolled version needed eight more lines for a 3 x 3 matrix and twenty-seven more for a 5 x 5.
